text:
Nameless love, destined realm

of being and of not being there. Your sudden siege

sustains my pain and cancels the tedium

of exhausted cup or pressed wine.


In a high silence, an aquiline

blue span of silence, I live. In the midst

of the ill-fated patience of your siege

I open the cages and overflow the trill.


For you I hang crowns on the walls;

for you I am more fugitive and in ripe

dreamings I lighten your songs.


And I carry you in my being and you have gathered

the attitude that in Florences or Byzantiums

consecrates its doves to oblivion.

translation.title: Nameless Love
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the nameless love as siege, silence, and consecration to oblivion.
